channel.title: North Wales Chronicle - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from North Wales Chronicle (northwaleschronicle.co.uk)

item.title: Holyhead ex-DWP boss sold illegal tobacco products for more than a year
item.description: A former Department of Work and Pensions (DWP) boss from Holyhead sold tobacco illegally for more than a year.

item.title: Just one Chester to Llandudno service left uncancelled ahead of Storm Goretti
item.description: Storm Goretti's incoming high winds, heavy rains, sleet and deep snow has led to multiple cancellations out of Chester railway station.

item.title: North Wales health board declare critical incident ahead of Storm Goretti
item.description: Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board (BCUHB) have declared an internal critical incident ahead of Storm Goretti hitting North Wales.

item.title: RECAP: Conwy, Denbighshire & Gwynedd prepare for snow from Storm Goretti
item.description: Storm Goretti is likely to bring heavy snow, leading to disruption and difficult travelling conditions later on Thursday and into Friday. A Yellow Weather Warning for snow is in place for parts of North Wales from 5pm today until midday on Friday. This includes areas of Conwy, Denbighshire and Gwynedd. item.title: Gabby Logan's dad and Welsh football legend, Terry Yorath, dies aged 75
item.description: Gabby Logan's Dad, former Leeds and Wales footballer Terry Yorath, has died at the age of 75.

item.title: Hourly forecast as Storm Goretti brings risk of snow to Conwy, Denbighshire & Gwynedd
item.description: Corwen falls under the Amber warning, which extends northwards as far as Llanrwst (with Llanrwst itself remaining under the Yellow Weather Warning).

item.title: Council backs £66m plan to move Holyhead school hit by RAAC crisis
item.description: The next step in a plan to relocate a school blighted by the RAAC crumbling concrete crisis has been approved.

item.title: Patients and visitors no longer required to wear face masks at North Wales hospitals
item.description: This change follows a recent decrease in the number of cases of flu and other respiratory illnesses.

item.title: Storm Goretti: The North Wales trains services suspended today amid snow warning
item.description: Among the affected services is the Llandudno Junction to Llandudno line, which will not operate from 3pm.

item.title: Avalanche risk warning as severe winter conditions grip Yr Wyddfa
item.description: WALKERS and climbers are being warned of an increased risk of avalanches on Yr Wyddfa as severe winter conditions intensify.
